title: tune-nccl-streams-kernels-kv-cache-continuous-batching-for-tensor-parallel-overlap
author: Ethan Zhao
description: Motivation: Reduce multi-GPU tensor-parallel serving tail latency and improve throughput by increasing overlap between NCCL collectives and compute+kvcache activity. This change tunes NCCL stream priorities, adjusts kernel launch sequencing for better compute/comm overlap, and improves KV cache continuous batching to avoid blocking collectives. Summary of changes: 1) add configurable NCCL stream priority groups and a scheduling policy that pins large collectives to low-priority comm streams while keeping small/latency-sensitive kernels on high-priority compute streams; 2) introduce an adaptive kernel-cmp/comm scheduler that delays non-critical kernel launches when it increases overlap; 3) refactor kv_cache continuous batching to use per-GPU non-blocking flush with backpressure tokens to avoid head-of-line blocking; 4) add microbench harness and perf tests for TP collectives/kv-cache interactions; 5) expose two new runtime flags: --tp-comm-priority-policy and --kvcb-backpressure-window. Results: internal perf lab shows 8-18% throughput improvement on 8-GPU A100 TP configs for long-context chat workloads and up to 1.6x reduction in p99 inter-GPU stall time for workloads with high kv cache hit churn. Tradeoffs: slight increase (1-3ms) in p50 for single-request latency in some narrow configs due to batched flush delay; guarded behind rollout flag. Checklist: - [x] design doc link: Linear ENG-1427 - [x] unit tests added for scheduler edge cases - [x] integration perf tests added and green - [x] feature-flagged rollout - [x] runtime config documented in ops/README - [x] release notes drafted. This PR is focused on runtime scheduling and kernel ordering; it does not change public API behaviors. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve current behavior unless flags changed. Rolling strategy: staged rollout via canary on Dedicated clusters followed by full rollout.

release_notes:
- Tune NCCL stream priorities and introduce adaptive kernel/comm scheduler to increase compute/comm overlap for tensor-parallel workloads.
- Refactor KV cache continuous batching to non-blocking flush with backpressure tokens, reducing inter-GPU stalls.
- Performance: +8-18% throughput on 8-GPU TP configs; reduced p99 inter-GPU stall time by up to 1.6x.
- Flags: --tp-comm-priority-policy (options: legacy|adaptive), --kvcb-backpressure-window (ms).
